messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Duloxetine is a selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor antidepressant (SSNRI).
Duloxetine affects chemicals in the brain that may be unbalanced in people with depression.
Duloxetine is used to treat major depressive disorder in adults.
Duloxetine is also used to treat general anxiety disorder in adults and children who are at least 7 years old.
Duloxetine is also used in adults to treat nerve pain caused by diabetes (diabetic neuropathy).
It is also used to treat chronic muscle or joint pain (such as low back pain and osteoarthritis pain).
Some brands of duloxetine are also used to treat fibromyalgia (a chronic pain disorder).
Drizalma is for treating fibromyalgia only in adults.
Cymbalta may be used to treat fibromyalgia in adults and children at least 13 years old.
Triplet: ["Duloxetine", "has drug class", "selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor antidepressant"]

The relation 'has drug class' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is classified under the pharmacological category specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'includes': The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'has controlled substance schedule': The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
